claim: In bandwidth-limited environments, active reward learning with many queries is infeasible due to the high-dimensionality of natural images requiring hundreds of queries, which cannot be transmitted during a mission.
falsifier: In a simulated bandwidth-limited mission, measure the number of queries that can be transmitted and compare to the number required by active reward learning algorithms to achieve a given reward model accuracy.

conditions: bandwidth-limited environments such as deep sea
high-dimensional natural images requiring hundreds of queries to learn a reward model
exclusions: limited to the reported system, task, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished

title: Bandwidth limitation–infeasibility of sending many boundary

claim: Out-of-distribution data poses significant challenges to the evaluation capabilities of LLM evaluators, leading to lower performance.
falsifier: Test whether LLM evaluators show statistically significant performance drops on OOD evaluation sets compared to in-distribution sets.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported OOD test set and the specific evaluators tested; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Out-of-distribution data–evaluation capabilities principle
